business_summary: Winner Medical Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, and sale of disposable medical products in China and internationally. It operates in two segments, Medical Consumables and Consumer Products. The company offers wound care solutions, including gauzes, bandages, adhesive and film dressings, cotton and non-woven products, basic kits, liquid skin protectants, debridement and exudate management products, anti-adhesion wound care, scar repair products, antimicrobial solutions, and biological active and compression treatment products; and operating room solutions, such as masks, gloves, protective apparel, surgical gowns and drapes, speciality drapes and packs, operating room solution accessories, general surgical kits and trays, and surgical consumables for pets. It also provides home care solutions comprising wound care products, which includes adhesive and silicone bandages, as well as first aid kits; and personal care products, such as incontinence, cosmetics, other cotton products, and foot, daily, sports, ear, nose, and throat care products, as well as hygiene products comprising panty liners, sanitary napkins, tampons, breast and maternity pads, disposable underwear, and baby diapers. In addition, the company is involved in technology promotion services; engineering and technology research and experimental development; manufacturing of medical instruments, equipment, and devices; software and information technology services; production of rubber and chemical products; and trading and consulting services. It sells its products under the Winner Medical, Purcotton, and PureH2B brands through sales teams, hospitals, e-commerce, and pharmacy and chain stores. The company serves the hospital, pharmacy, PPE, consumer, and industrial field industries. It exports its products. The company was founded in 1991 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, China. Winner Medical Co., Ltd. is a subsidiary of Winner Group Limited.
business_summary_ko: Winner Medical Co., Ltd.는 자회사와 함께 중국 및 국제적으로 일회용 의료 제품의 연구, 개발, 생산 및 판매에 참여하고 있습니다. 의료 소모품과 소비재라는 두 가지 부문으로 운영됩니다. 이 회사는 거즈, 붕대, 접착제 및 필름 드레싱, 면 및 부직포 제품, 기본 키트, 액체 피부 보호제, 괴사조직 제거 및 삼출물 관리 제품, 유착 방지 상처 관리, 흉터 복구 제품, 항균 솔루션, 생물학적 활성 및 압축 치료 제품을 포함한 상처 관리 솔루션을 제공합니다. 마스크, 장갑, 보호복, 수술용 가운 및 드레이프, 특수 드레이프 및 팩, 수술실 솔루션 액세서리, 일반 수술 키트 및 트레이, 애완동물용 수술 소모품과 같은 수술실 솔루션을 포함합니다. 또한 접착제와 실리콘 붕대를 포함한 상처 관리 제품과 구급 상자로 구성된 홈 케어 솔루션도 제공합니다. 요실금, 화장품, 기타 면 제품, 발, 일일, 스포츠, 귀, 코, 목 관리 제품과 같은 개인 위생 제품뿐만 아니라 팬티 라이너, 생리대, 탐폰, 브리즈로 구성된 위생 제품
